referencePolicy: Agent-source-checked references are diagnostic only; humanReview pending excludes claims of human-golden accuracy.

tolerances.normalizedAmount: half last displayed source unit times unit multiplier

numericDenominator: All required before/after revenue, parent net profit, operating cash flow and their three changes; missing answers count as wrong. 9 per company, 36 development items.
supportDenominator: All substantive report claims; each also requires a question coverage check. Zero claims is undefined and incomplete.
completionDenominator: All 12 registered development questions. partial, failed, cancelled and unsupported do not complete; unsupported is reported separately and never used as a comparative accuracy baseline.

judge.mode: source-check plus independent human review before acceptance

usage: Missing provider usage is unknown; estimated reservations recorded separately. Prices unknown unless verified. Cost per success undefined when zero successes.
comparisonPolicy: Same tasks, frozen files, model, budgets, rubric and capability range only. Full double-period capability baseline begins at S13.
